newsitem.title: USA: Middletown, Conn. approves $44.7 mln school budget.
newsitem.headline: Middletown, Conn. approves $44.7 mln school budget.

text.p: The Middletown School Board approved a proposed 1997-1998 budget of about $44.7 million, almost a 5.7 percent increase from current spending, the Hartford Cournat rported Friday.
The board passed the measure on Tuesday.

The proposed budget increase comes to about $2.51 million, with most of it intended for salary increases for existing staff, new staff to serve a growing student enrollment and increases in transportation and utility costs, the paper reported.
The school budget goes to Mayor Maria Madsen Holzberg for review, who will then present her spending plan to the common council next year.
